name: Notice of Period of Performance Extension
description: Written notice of a no-cost extension of a federal award's period of performance, stating the reasons and revised period.
deadline: At least 10 calendar days before the end of the period of performance
quote: The Director of Business Services will develop the required written notice, including the reasons for the extension and revised period of performance; the notice will be issued no later than ten (10) calendar days prior to the end of the currently documented period of performance in the federal award.
